required_fixes: 1. Measure the claim object, not a substitute: commit distill_parameterized() durably to src/spider/kernel.py and induce the parameterized mechanism through it before outcome-bearing B measurement. The kernel at the provenance commit (sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) has no distill_parameterized; provenance.json records has_distill_parameterized=false and kernel.py's distill() docstring states parameter induction 'must earn that capability through C-PARAM-INHERIT'. The harness-level distill_parameterized_harness (run_experiment.py:102-175) substitutes a bespoke object; prior C-PARAM-INHERIT audits (codex/claim_state.json EXP-GRAPH-35876306030, EXP-GRAPH-35918640311, EXP-GRAPH-35932480731) treated this same kernel state as a binding gate failure.

2. Make the transfer hypothesis satisfiable by the frozen mechanism definition, or re-freeze: prereg 5.3 induces preconditions {auth:valid_token, resource:posts} and template GET /posts/${id}, while prereg 5.4 tests on context {resource:users}. kernel._matches is exact key/value equality and resolve() returns UNKNOWN with no candidates on any non-matching context (kernel.py:93-110), so UNKNOWN on B is deterministic. Even if preconditions matched, _bind would produce /posts/6..10, which the substrate rejects (posts only 1..5; substrate_app.py:116-118). The falsifier ('cannot resolve/bind/execute/verify on resource B at all') is therefore unreachable-as-evidence: it is satisfied by the design itself regardless of any capability of parameter-slot mechanisms. Generalize preconditions and/or parameterize the base path (e.g. /${resource}/${id}) before re-freezing.

3. Implement B-COLD per its frozen expected_behavior ('Low success rate, high cost (many HTTP requests), zero false accepts'; spec.json baselines.B-COLD): a cold agent must explore candidate endpoints. The current implementation hardcodes the correct base path (run_experiment.py:260 base_url = '/users' for B) and succeeds 5/5 in one direct request each — an oracle baseline, not cold exploration.

4. Fix the decision rule so SUPPORTS is reachable: with cold at 1.0, D1_SUCCESS_B requires success_rate_B_param > 1.10 (impossible for any rate); with literal at cost 0.0, D2_COST_B requires cost_per_task_B_param < 0.0 (impossible for any count). The conjunctive rule can never pass, so ANY_FAIL -> FALSIFIES is structurally forced and the outcome carries no information about the hypothesis. A mechanism that never executes (resolution UNKNOWN, 0 HTTP) must be scored INCONCLUSIVE on those tasks, not counted as 0-cost 'success'; otherwise D2 rewards non-execution.

5. B-LITERAL-REPLAY must actually attempt the exact replay on resource B (frozen: 'agent attempts exact replay on resource B... zero cost if it fails fast') and must run with a registry containing ONLY literal mechanisms. The run resolved UNKNOWN with 0 HTTP for all 5 tasks (no replay was attempted; report.md section 6.2 claim 'Replays exact /posts/1' contradicts raw_results.json which records 0 requests), and the literal baseline executed after the parameterized mechanism was upserted (main() order run_experiment.py:435,445) so its registry contained 6 mechanisms including the param mechanism (registry.jsonl).

6. Implement B-RETRIEVAL-KNN as frozen ('Embed intent+context, retrieve top-k from resource A observations, adapt action template naively') or rename and re-freeze the actual weak behavior: the current code uses train_observations[0].action with a string replace /posts/ -> /users/ (run_experiment.py:351-364), yielding GET /users/1 — identifier 1 is outside B's exclusive 6..10 space, so success is guaranteed 0.0% and there is no embedding, retrieval, or top-k.

7. Satisfy V1_SUBSTRATE for the artifact actually used: Runtime validated Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.13.0 HS256 on port 18927 (EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583, audit PASS) and port 18928 (EXP-RUNTIME-34015740602, audit REVISE with producer claim not supported) against /api-data profile endpoints with 4 auth states — not this new /posts /users /comments app, which the producer's own validity note says was 'not independently re-validated in this run' (run_experiment.py:531). Remove the false 'deterministic jitter' claim (substrate_app.py:39-42 uses unseeded random.uniform per request) and retain substrate-side per-request logs so V4_HONEST_COST is independently verifiable rather than harness self-reported.

8. Encode the outcome honestly: result.json status=COMPLETE/outcome=FALSIFIES transmits a non-discriminating measurement as a scientific falsification. Per EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md, design/substrate invalidity must never be encoded as falsification; the packet should use the INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID semantics and document the degenerate baselines and unsatisfiable decision thresholds in validity_notes.

validity_findings.finding: Claim object not measured: the experiment induces the parameterized mechanism with a harness-level function (run_experiment.py:102-175) because src/spider/kernel.py at provenance commit d14f4f87 (sha256 46929b3a... verified at HEAD also) has no distill_parameterized. C-PARAM-INHERIT is a claim about kernel mechanism capability; the measured object is experiment-local code, so neither the observed failure nor any success could be attributed to the kernel.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/provenance.json (kernel.sha256, has_distill_parameterized=false); src/spider/kernel.py (distill() literal-only docstring; no distill_parameterized symbol); run_experiment.py:102-175; report.md:137-141; prior binding-gate audits in codex/claim_state.json (EXP-GRAPH-35876306030, EXP-GRAPH-35918640311, EXP-GRAPH-35932480731)
validity_findings.impact: Zero scientific evidence about the kernel's parameterization capability is produced by this run; the producer's FALSIFIES cannot bear on C-PARAM-INHERIT as claimed.

validity_findings.finding: Transfer failure is a design tautology: prereg 5.3 fixes preconditions {auth:valid_token, resource:posts} and template GET /posts/${id}; prereg 5.4 tests context {resource:users}; kernel._matches is exact equality and resolve() returns UNKNOWN for any non-matching context (kernel.py:93-110). All 5 param test-B resolutions are UNKNOWN with 0 HTTP — the mechanism never executes on B because the design forbids it. Even with matching preconditions, the bound path /posts/${id} could not serve B (substrate serves /users/{id} only for 6..10, /posts/{id} only for 1..5).
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/prereg.md:50-71 (5.3/5.4); raw_results.json test_B.param.details (all UNKNOWN, 0 requests); kernel.py:14-20 (_matches), 93-123 (resolve); substrate_app.py:113-126
validity_findings.impact: Observed 0% success on B is determined by the frozen design before any run; it cannot discriminate 'parameter induction fails to transfer' from 'this mechanism encoding cannot express transfer'.

validity_findings.finding: Decision instrument is degenerate: D1_SUCCESS_B (success_rate_B_param > max baseline + 0.10) is unsatisfiable because the oracle cold baseline fixed max at 1.0 (1.0 + 0.10 = 1.10 > maximum possible success rate); D2_COST_B (cost < min baseline x 0.80) is unsatisfiable because the do-nothing literal baseline fixed min at 0.0 (0.0 x 0.80 = 0.0, and cost < 0.0 is impossible). Therefore the frozen ANY_FAIL -> FALSIFIES outcome is forced for every conceivable mechanism outcome; the run cannot possibly yield SUPPORTS and hence cannot scientifically falsify either.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/raw_results.json decision_rule (D1 max_baseline 1.0 threshold >1.10; D2 min_baseline 0.0 threshold <0.0); spec.json decision_rule (D1, D2); run_experiment.py:476-522
validity_findings.impact: The FALSIFIES outcome is an artifact of the test instrument, not evidence about parameterized transfer.

validity_findings.finding: B-COLD baseline contradicts its own frozen expected_behavior: spec.json defines B-COLD as 'agent must explore', expected 'Low success rate, high cost (many HTTP requests), zero false accepts', but run_cold_baseline hardcodes the correct endpoint mapping (base_url = '/users' for B, run_experiment.py:260) and succeeds 5/5 with exactly 1 request per task. The 'cold' agent is given the answer it is supposed to discover.
validity_findings.impact: Inflates the best-baseline success to the ceiling (1.0), which combined with VF3 makes D1 impossible; also misrepresents baseline strength to the reader.

validity_findings.finding: B-LITERAL-REPLAY never replays: frozen behavior is 'agent attempts exact replay on resource B... zero cost if it fails fast', but all 5 tasks resolved UNKNOWN with 0 HTTP requests (raw_results.json test_B.literal), because the literal mechanisms' precondition {resource:posts} fails exact-match against context {resource:users} before any execution. report.md section 6.2 ('Replays exact /posts/1 etc.') misdescribes the raw evidence. The baseline also ran with a contaminated registry: the parameterized mechanism was upserted before the literal baseline executed (run_experiment.py:435 vs 445), so registry.jsonl held 6 mechanisms (5 literal + 1 param), violating the frozen 'Registry contains only literal mechanisms from resource A (no parameter slots)' condition.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/raw_results.json test_B.literal.details (resolution UNKNOWN, requests 0); registry.jsonl (6 lines incl. param-fetch-resource-by-id-906d99c7); run_experiment.py:290-331, 435, 445; report.md:168
validity_findings.impact: The 0.0 cost of the literal baseline is 'did nothing', not 'failed fast'; D2's cost reference is a do-nothing baseline, and baseline isolation (empty-of-param registry) is violated.

validity_findings.finding: B-RETRIEVAL-KNN is not the frozen KNN baseline: frozen implementation is 'Embed intent+context, retrieve top-k from resource A observations, adapt action template naively (string replace)'; the implementation takes train_observations[0].action and string-replaces the path, producing GET /users/1 (run_experiment.py:351-364). Identifier 1 is not in B's exclusive test space (6..10), so all 5 probes 404 — success is guaranteed 0% independent of any retrieval quality; no embedding, retrieval, or top-k exists.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/spec.json:19-23 (B-RETRIEVAL-KNN); run_experiment.py:334-386; raw_results.json test_B.knn (0/5, 1 request each); substrate_app.py:124-125 (/users only 6..10)
validity_findings.impact: Baseline strength is misrepresented; the D1 success reference point and the 'beat all three baselines' framing are distorted by a baseline that cannot succeed by construction.

validity_findings.finding: V1_SUBSTRATE only pattern-level for the artifact used: the substrate is a new Flask app (endpoints /posts, /users, /comments, port 18928) whose own validity note says it was 'not independently re-validated in this run' (run_experiment.py:531). The validated Runtime ceilings attach to /api-data profile endpoints: EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583 (port 18927, audit PASS) and EXP-RUNTIME-34015740602 (port 18928, audit REVISE with producer claim not supported). The 'deterministic jitter' comment (substrate_app.py:39-42) is false: random.uniform is unseeded, so latency is stochastic per request; response bodies are deterministic, so V6 in the strict response sense holds, but the deterministic-fingerprint component of V1 is not met. No substrate-side request log exists, so V4_HONEST_COST is only harness self-report.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/substrate_app.py:32-42,113-139; run_experiment.py:531; codex/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583/audit.json (PASS, port 18927); codex/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-34015740602/audit.json (REVISE, producer_claim_supported=false, port 18928); artifacts list in result.json (no request logs)
validity_findings.impact: V1 as frozen ('verified by Runtime lane... or equivalent') is only partially satisfied; reproducibility is limited and one of the two cited Runtime precedents did not pass its own audit.

validity_findings.finding: Controls pass but are non-discriminating: NC-UNRELATED-RESOURCE passes (false_accept_rate_C_param 0.0, all UNKNOWN) for the same exact-match precondition refusal that blocks the B test — the null control cannot distinguish 'mechanism is safely abstaining' from 'mechanism is useless off its train resource'. PC-A-SEEN passes (success_rate_A_param_seen 1.0, 1 request per task) but only demonstrates the harness+registry+resolve pipeline on the train resource, consistent with the mechanism having memorized resource A's path.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-36118890504/raw_results.json null_control_C.details (all UNKNOWN), positive_control_A.details (5/5, 1 request each); result.json controls
validity_findings.impact: Control passes do not add measuring power to the invalid B test; they are consistent but trivially satisfied.

baseline_findings.expected_behavior_frozen: Conjunctive D1-D5; ALL_PASS -> SUPPORTS, ANY_FAIL -> FALSIFIES (spec.json:46-87)
baseline_findings.observed: D1 fail (0.0 > 1.10 false), D2 fail (0.0 < 0.0 false), D3/D4/D5 pass; outcome FALSIFIES (raw_results.json decision_rule)

FALSIFIES is structurally forced; the run cannot support the hypothesis under any possible parameterized-mechanism behavior, and therefore cannot falsify it either. The three baselines as implemented cannot serve as discriminating reference points.

claim_ceiling: Producer's FALSIFIES ceiling is not justified. Maximum justified ceiling: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains at the prior narrow EXPERIMENTAL synthetic in-kernel ceiling — EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 (10/10 same-resource unseen single-char identifiers on the kernel POC) — plus the historical record that the kernel's parameterized induction has never been durably committed and no valid A-to-B cross-resource measurement exists (codex/claim_state.json events through EXP-GRAPH-35932480731). This packet adds no evidence for or against cross-resource parameterized transfer: the kernel capability itself was not measured, the frozen mechanism could not express the transfer by construction (VF2), the baselines and decision thresholds force FALSIFIES regardless of mechanism quality (VF3/VF4/VF5), and the two remaining supplier findings are authentication-context/registry details (VF5) and a mislabeled KNN baseline (VF6). 'Product must not promote parameterized mechanisms' remains the existing bound (claim stays non-VALIDATED); it is not newly established by this run.
